title: Findings Array
description: Schema for findings JSON used across all pipeline stages. Consumed by save_findings.py and run_checks.py.

stage.description: Pipeline stage that produced this finding.

severity.description: Severity level of the finding. 'info' is for context-only findings that provide data for other pipeline steps but do not represent a risk.

artifact_ref.description: Reference to the artifact and statement (e.g. 'template.json (Statement 2)').

verification.description: Whether the finding is proof-backed (Access Analyzer), verified against SAR, or needs human review ('unverified').

fix_before.description: Optional JSON snippet showing the current state before the suggested fix.

fix_after.description: Optional JSON snippet showing the suggested fix.

disposition.description: Resolution state: 'accepted' (risk acknowledged with justification), 'fixed' (addressed in policy), or null/absent (open — not yet resolved).

justification.description: Required when disposition is 'accepted'. Explains why the finding's risk is acceptable for this use case.
